title: Matibag gets US Secret Service recognition for $206M counterfeit haul

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Melvin Matibag has been recognized by the US Secret Service after the bureau seized $206 million worth of counterfeit US currency and financial instruments in Pasay City last March. A certificate of appreciation signed by US Secret Service Guam Resident Agent in Charge Amy Knowlton Baylon cited Matibag’s “exceptional investigative efforts and dedication in dismantling a major counterfeit currency operation.” “Your professionalism, commitment, and contributions to protecting the integrity of the U.S. financial system are sincerely appreciated,” the certificate also read.
